# local-agent

> An experimental local-first terminal coding agent for Ollama, built on Bun, rendered with Tuimark.

local-agent runs on macOS and Linux from source with Bun 1.4.2 and a local
Ollama. It can inspect repositories, edit files, run commands, call MCP tools,
and keep opt-in durable sessions. Mutating effects require approval by
default; plan mode removes the mutating tools at the host. On macOS,
commands can run in an opt-in Seatbelt sandbox (no network, writes only in
the workspace); nothing else is sandboxed. The historical Go releases remain available on
GitHub Releases; this site documents the current client.

## Documentation

- [Getting started](https://local-agent.dev/getting-started): Install Ollama and local-agent, then begin a local coding session.
- [Modes](https://local-agent.dev/modes): plan and build intents, host-enforced authority, approvals.
- [Ollama models](https://local-agent.dev/ollama-models): Default model, context limits, admission checks.
- [Providers](https://local-agent.dev/providers): Local Ollama and the Chalupa environment profile.
- [Sessions](https://local-agent.dev/sessions): Experimental opt-in session database, resume, and inspection.
- [Configuration](https://local-agent.dev/configuration): Environment variables, themes, AGENTS.md.
- [Command reference](https://local-agent.dev/reference): CLI flags, slash commands, keymap, headless and JSON output.
- [MCP integrations](https://local-agent.dev/mcp): Direct server config, namespaced tools, status checks, approval.
- [Safety and privacy](https://local-agent.dev/safety): Local-first boundaries, approvals, what it does not guarantee.
- [Architecture](https://local-agent.dev/architecture): The Bun monorepo, the Tuimark client, and the runtime.
- [Testing](https://local-agent.dev/testing): Vitest, Glyphrun terminal contracts, CI.
- [Ecosystem](https://local-agent.dev/ecosystem): Related focused tools and their boundaries.

## Stack

- [Tuimark](https://tuimark.dev): the terminal UI engine that renders the client.
- [Glyphrun](https://glyphrun.dev): black-box terminal contract tests.
